name: uppr
description: A Go-based deployment control plane for managing applications and Git repositories across self-hosted Linux infrastructure. It generates Docker Compose, Caddy, and runtime configuration, then verifies deployments and proxy reloads.

name: Artif4ct
description: A single-binary, AI-native knowledge platform for publishing markdown-backed documents, forms, quizzes, and chat experiences with persistent artifact context, portable backups, and usage tracking.

name: Finli
description: A financial document automation system used across two restaurant operations. It sorts receipts, creates location-specific invoices, and merges PDFs through configurable CLI and local web workflows.
